clips.title: The story
paras: Dark Iron dwarves hold Ironband's Compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh. Once Sturgy Ironband's camp, it now threatens travelers and nearby settlements.

Dark Iron dwarves hold the compound south of Helm's Bed Lake. Sturgy Ironband first established the camp as a staging post in Dun Morogh's snowy wilderness. Dark Iron infiltrators pushed deep into Bronzebeard territory and seized it. Now their forces threaten travelers and nearby settlements, close to Ironforge.

The Dark Iron camp stands within Dun Morogh's borders, a serious provocation to Ironforge. The city keeps watch and sends seasoned warriors to recover fallen scouts and secure vital intelligence about the Dark Iron threat in the mountain kingdom.
